title: Cosmic Egg Portal
description: A surreal composite image divided into distinct sections. The top half shows a barren moon-like landscape with a large crater, a giant tentacled skull, white lotus flowers, and a glowing cosmic egg character with large eyes floating before a swirling galaxy portal. The bottom half features a red swirling liquid with lotus flowers and blue birds on the left, transitioning to intricate circular mosaic patterns in blue, teal, and gold on the right.
prompt: Surreal composite scene split horizontally. Top section: barren grey moon surface with large crater, giant Lovecraftian skull emerging from ground, white lotus flowers, and a cute round egg-like character with big eyes and arms floating in front of a massive swirling orange and blue galaxy portal in space. Bottom left: vibrant red swirling water with pink lotus flowers and small blue birds. Bottom right: intricate circular mosaic tile patterns in shades of teal, blue, and gold. Dreamlike and psychedelic atmosphere.
